description: Defines the AWCContainerBase class, which inherits from BaseRefCount<IContainer> and provides interface methods for memory, processor, and network information within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: AWCContainerBase
classes.description: A class that provides a base implementation for container objects with reference counting, exposing methods for retrieving container ID, memory info, processor info, and network interfaces.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container with a given ID.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information associated with the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information associated with the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network interfaces associated with the container.
